q: Multiplying a number by another number makes it bigger.
why: Only when you multiply a positive number by something bigger than 1. 10 × 0.5 = 5, and 10 × (−2) = −20.

q: Dividing a positive number by a number between 0 and 1 makes it bigger.
why: 10 ÷ 0.5 = 20: the question is how many halves fit into 10. Smaller pieces means more of them.
